$note: Curated meta text for the Property Financials dataset builder (plan T9a). Numeric meta (periods, categories) is derived; only the text here is carried through. `generated` is the dataset stamp (deterministic builds: the CLI does not stamp the clock unless --generated is passed).
title: ORA Property Financials Normalized Dataset
noi_definition: revenue (excl. security-deposit receipts and prepaid rent: AppFolio unallocated prepays and Yardi prepaid rental income alike) minus recurring opex
history_note: history[entity]: monthly(bool), yr[year] and ytd[year] (Jan-Sep) with br, rev, opex, noi, cats{opex category}, rc{revenue category}, n months; months{g,br,rv,ox,tx} monthly series; ev[] net base-rent steps; drv[period] account-level drivers with nature (recurring|lumpy|mixed|annual). Years with n<12 are partial.
portfolio_note: Same-store excludes lease-up and partial-history assets (9620 State 350, 3034 Westerville, 3875-3883 Livingston). FY view adds the two entity-level statements (55 New Plant, 1851 South Club Solar). TTM/YTD views use PM monthly exports only.
